Your JavaScript API

Build code runs on Apply. Combat code runs every 250ms. Scripts run in a separate worker with a one-second time limit. This is a learning sandbox; do not paste secrets.

Build & upgrade

build("fire", 1); // element, pad (1–10)
upgrade(1, "water"); // pad, optional second element
sell(1); // refund 60%
log(gold);
// Available: gold, wave, towers, enemies

Towers cost 60 gold. Upgrade costs 80 × current level (maximum level 3). Level 2 can add a second element. Buildings cannot occupy the path.

Combat

for (const tower of towers) {
  const candidates = enemies.filter(enemy =>
    distance(tower, enemy) <= tower.range);
  candidates.sort((a, b) => b.progress - a.progress);
  if (candidates.length) {
    attack(tower.id, candidates[0].id);
  }
}

Enemy fields: id, x, y, hp, maxHp, element, progress. Tower fields: id, pad, x, y, element, secondary, level, range. attack() respects range and cooldown. Without a combat script towers target the first enemy automatically; applying a script gives it full targeting control.
